text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fiercely contested Yayoi Sho has 
ended.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the race, Manhattan Cafe 
sensed "her friend" ahead of Agnes 
Tachyon, and resolved to chase after her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hoping to run alongside Agnes Tachyon, 
Manhattan Cafe wishes to enter the Satsuki 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Manhattan Cafe's poor physical 
condition was a concern. Aiming for the 
Satsuki Sho or Nippon Derby in this state 
would be a gamble.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deciding to see how things went through 
the spring races, she set her sights on 
the St. Lite Kinen in the autumn as her 
target race.
